episodes.synopsis: Tanzaburo Tojima has always idolized Kamen Rider, to the point of wanting to be him. He turns 40 this year...
episodes.title: Tojima Wants to Be a Kamen Rider

episodes.synopsis: Yuriko Okada has always idolized Electro-Wave Human Tackle. But seeing Tojima forces her into action...
episodes.title: I Am Tackle

episodes.synopsis: After their encounter with the real Shocker, Tojima meets someone who knows more about the evil organization.
episodes.title: I Love the Moment When Hate Turns to Love

episodes.synopsis: Mitsuba's girlfriend, Yukarisu, transforms into a Shocker Combatant and attacks Yuriko!
episodes.title: Who Is the Strongest Kamen Rider?

episodes.synopsis: Mitsuba's girlfriend, Yukarisu, is a member of Shocker. What will he do protect her from his brother, Ichiyo?
episodes.title: Let Me Be V3 Too

episodes.synopsis: The gang gathers at a pub to discuss what's happened. But it's owner is Ichiyo and Mitsuba's resentful sister.
episodes.title: Order Some Snacks

episodes.synopsis: Nakao has a fateful encounter that makes him recount how he ended up as a Shocker-idolizing yakuza.
episodes.title: Let Me Join Shocker

episodes.synopsis: Tojima and the gang now know that both Shocker and monsters are real. What's next?
episodes.title: What's a Kamen Rider Do When A Dangerous Enemy Appears?

episodes.synopsis: The tournament to decide the strongest begins, with Yukarisu and Tojima facing off.
episodes.title: Show Me Your Rider

episodes.synopsis: Yuriko and Tojima clash, with her superior technique frustrated by his bottomless resilience and power...
episodes.title: Risk Your Life

episodes.synopsis: Both worn out from their previous battles, the tournament concludes with Mitsuba VS Yuriko.
episodes.title: Tackle is the Strongest

episodes.synopsis: The gang has an unexpected encounter at Futaba's pub.
episodes.title: I'll Take All You Riders On

episodes.synopsis: Futaba's rage towards her brother, Ichiyo, reaches it's breaking point.
episodes.title: I Will Fight, and Die, Against Shocker

episodes.synopsis: Will Futaba still be able to deny the existence of Shocker when she finds herself in a fight against Kumota?
episodes.title: I Want to Learn More About Humans

episodes.synopsis: An encounter with a man from Sena's past deepens Kumota's curiosity about humans.
episodes.title: The Masked Idol, Heavy Chop

episodes.synopsis: Thunder Raiko finally comes for Yukarisu. Will the Riders be able to protect her from the Shocker assassin?
episodes.title: An Imposter Can't Beat the Real Deal

episodes.synopsis: Tojima reels from the most recent battle, while Ito, Sato, and Ishige stumble onto Bat Man's wicked plot...
episodes.title: Everyone In The World Will Join Shocker

episodes.synopsis: Nakao and his underlings find a surprising sanctuary, as the Bat Man's Shocker idols continue to hunt them.
episodes.title: I'll Fight Shocker Too
It'd Be an Honor to Die as a Rider

episodes.synopsis: Ichiyo introduces Nakao to someone who seems poised to figure out what it is he's lacking.
episodes.title: I Was Craving a Battle With Shocker

episodes.synopsis: Thunder Raiko tracks Nakao down, but his training has made him more than she can handle at first.
episodes.title: Becoming the Ultimate Monster

episodes.synopsis: Tojima and his fellow Riders unite, out to stop the Bat Man's mass recruitment scheme for Shocker.
episodes.title: Shocker is on the Move

episodes.synopsis: The Bat Man intends to convert every visitor at an arena into a Shocker Combatant. Can the Riders stop him?
episodes.title: Let's Do This, Shocker!

episodes.synopsis: Tojima and the Riders finally square off against the Bat Man. But can humans really defeat a Shocker monster?
episodes.title: I Wouldn't Mind Dying Today
